question: How many matches does the cricket graph hold?
paraphrases: How many cricket matches are in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match) RETURN count(m) AS matches

question: How many players are in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player) RETURN count(p) AS players

question: How many matches were played in each format?
paraphrases: Break the matches down by match type.
cypher: MATCH (m:Match) RETURN m.match_type AS format, count(*) AS matches ORDER BY matches DESC

question: How many women's matches does the graph hold?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match {gender: 'female'}) RETURN count(m) AS matches

question: What are the dates of the earliest and the latest match?
paraphrases: Which period does the cricket data cover?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match) RETURN min(m.date) AS first_match, max(m.date) AS last_match

question: How many seasons does the graph cover?
cypher: MATCH (s:Season) RETURN count(s) AS seasons

question: How many matches ended in a draw, a tie or no result?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match) WHERE m.winner IN ['draw', 'tie', 'no result'] RETURN m.winner AS result, count(*) AS matches ORDER BY matches DESC

question: How often did the side that won the toss choose to bat, and how often to field?
cypher: MATCH (:Team)-[w:WON_TOSS]->(:Match) RETURN w.decision AS decision, count(*) AS tosses ORDER BY tosses DESC

question: How many matches were played in the {tournament}?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: $tournament}) RETURN count(m) AS matches

question: How many matches has {team} played?
cypher: MATCH (t:Team {name: $team})-[:COMPETED_IN]->(m:Match) RETURN count(m) AS matches

question: How many player-of-the-match awards has {player} won?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player {name: $player})-[:PLAYER_OF_MATCH]->(m:Match) RETURN count(m) AS awards

question: How many matches were played in {city}?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match)-[:HOSTED_AT]->(v:Venue {city: $city}) RETURN count(m) AS matches

question: How are batsmen most often dismissed?
paraphrases: What are the most common ways of getting out?
cypher: MATCH (:Player)-[d:DISMISSED]->(:Player) RETURN d.kind AS how_out, count(*) AS dismissals ORDER BY dismissals DESC

question: Who are the ten highest run-scorers across all formats?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[b:BATTED_IN]->(:Match) RETURN p.name AS player, sum(b.runs) AS runs ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 10

question: Who are the ten highest run-scorers in {format} cricket?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[b:BATTED_IN]->(m:Match {match_type: $format}) RETURN p.name AS player, sum(b.runs) AS runs ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 10

question: Who took the most wickets in {format} cricket?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[b:BOWLED_IN]->(m:Match {match_type: $format}) RETURN p.name AS player, sum(b.wickets) AS wickets ORDER BY wickets DESC LIMIT 10

question: What are the five highest individual innings in the graph?
paraphrases: Which are the biggest individual scores?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[b:BATTED_IN]->(m:Match) RETURN p.name AS player, b.runs AS runs, b.balls AS balls, m.match_type AS format, m.date AS date ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 5

question: Who has hit the most sixes?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[b:BATTED_IN]->(:Match) RETURN p.name AS player, sum(b.sixes) AS sixes ORDER BY sixes DESC LIMIT 10

question: Who has hit the most fours in {format} cricket?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[b:BATTED_IN]->(m:Match {match_type: $format}) RETURN p.name AS player, sum(b.fours) AS fours ORDER BY fours DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many centuries has {player} scored?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player {name: $player})-[b:BATTED_IN]->(:Match) WHERE b.runs >= 100 RETURN count(*) AS centuries

question: Who has scored the most centuries?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[b:BATTED_IN]->(:Match) WHERE b.runs >= 100 RETURN p.name AS player, count(*) AS centuries ORDER BY centuries DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which bowlers have bowled the most maiden overs?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[b:BOWLED_IN]->(:Match) RETURN p.name AS player, sum(b.maidens) AS maidens ORDER BY maidens DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which bowlers took all ten wickets in an innings?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[b:BOWLED_IN]->(m:Match) WHERE b.wickets = 10 RETURN p.name AS player, m.match_type AS format, m.date AS date ORDER BY date

question: How many matches has {team} won?
cypher: MATCH (t:Team {name: $team})-[:WON]->(m:Match) RETURN count(m) AS wins

question: What share of its matches has {team} won?
cypher: MATCH (t:Team {name: $team})-[:COMPETED_IN]->(m:Match) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[w:WON]->(m) RETURN count(m) AS played, count(w) AS won, round(100.0 * count(w) / count(m), 1) AS win_pct

question: In how many decided matches did the side that won the toss also win the match?
paraphrases: Does winning the toss help win the match?
cypher: MATCH (t:Team)-[:WON_TOSS]->(m:Match) WHERE m.winner IN ['draw', 'tie', 'no result'] = false RETURN count(m) AS decided, sum(CASE WHEN m.winner = t.name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS toss_winner_won

question: Which fielders took part in the most catches?
cypher: MATCH (f:Player)-[d:FIELDED_DISMISSAL]->(:Player) WHERE d.kind = 'caught' RETURN f.name AS fielder, count(*) AS catches ORDER BY catches DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which wicket-keepers made the most stumpings?
cypher: MATCH (k:Player)-[d:FIELDED_DISMISSAL]->(:Player) WHERE d.kind = 'stumped' RETURN k.name AS keeper, count(*) AS stumpings ORDER BY stumpings DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which fielders were involved in the most run-outs?
cypher: MATCH (f:Player)-[d:FIELDED_DISMISSAL]->(:Player) WHERE d.kind = 'run out' RETURN f.name AS fielder, count(*) AS run_outs ORDER BY run_outs DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many matches were played in the {season} season?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match)-[:IN_SEASON]->(s:Season {year: $season}) RETURN count(m) AS matches

question: Which were the five biggest wins by runs?
cypher: MATCH (t:Team)-[:WON]->(m:Match) WHERE m.win_by_runs IS NOT NULL RETURN t.name AS winner, m.win_by_runs AS margin_runs, m.match_type AS format, m.date AS date ORDER BY margin_runs DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which teams has {player} played for?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player {name: $player})-[:PLAYED_FOR]->(t:Team) RETURN t.name AS team ORDER BY team

question: How many matches has {venue} hosted, counting every name it is recorded under?
paraphrases: How many games have been played at {venue}?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match)-[:HOSTED_AT]->(v:Venue) WHERE v.name = $venue OR v.name STARTS WITH $venue + ', ' RETURN count(m) AS matches

question: Which cities have hosted the most matches?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match)-[:HOSTED_AT]->(v:Venue) WHERE v.city IS NOT NULL RETURN v.city AS city, count(m) AS matches ORDER BY matches DESC LIMIT 10

question: Data check: how many grounds are recorded under two names, once with the city appended?
paraphrases: How many venues appear twice in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (a:Venue), (b:Venue) WHERE b.name = a.name + ', ' + a.city RETURN count(*) AS doubled_venues

question: How many times did {bowler} dismiss {batsman}?
cypher: MATCH (b:Player {name: $bowler})-[d:DISMISSED]->(x:Player {name: $batsman}) RETURN count(d) AS dismissals

question: How many matches have {team_a} and {team_b} played against each other, and how many did each win?
cypher: MATCH (a:Team {name: $team_a})-[:COMPETED_IN]->(m:Match)<-[:COMPETED_IN]-(b:Team {name: $team_b}) RETURN count(m) AS played, sum(CASE WHEN m.winner = a.name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS a_won, sum(CASE WHEN m.winner = b.name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b_won

question: Among batters who faced at least 2,000 balls in T20 cricket, who scored fastest?
paraphrases: Who has the best T20 strike rate (minimum 2,000 balls)?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[b:BATTED_IN]->(m:Match {match_type: 'T20'}) WITH p, sum(b.runs) AS runs, sum(b.balls) AS balls WHERE balls >= 2000 RETURN p.name AS player, runs, balls, round(100.0 * runs / balls, 1) AS strike_rate ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which bowlers have dismissed the most different batsmen?
cypher: MATCH (b:Player)-[:DISMISSED]->(x:Player) RETURN b.name AS bowler, count(DISTINCT x) AS distinct_batsmen ORDER BY distinct_batsmen DESC LIMIT 10

question: At which grounds has {player} scored the most runs?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player {name: $player})-[b:BATTED_IN]->(m:Match)-[:HOSTED_AT]->(v:Venue) RETURN v.name AS venue, sum(b.runs) AS runs ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 5

question: Who scored the most runs in the {tournament} in {season}?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[b:BATTED_IN]->(m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(:Tournament {name: $tournament}) MATCH (m)-[:IN_SEASON]->(:Season {year: $season}) RETURN p.name AS player, sum(b.runs) AS runs ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 5

question: Who has won the most player-of-the-match awards in the {tournament}?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:PLAYER_OF_MATCH]->(m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(:Tournament {name: $tournament}) RETURN p.name AS player, count(m) AS awards ORDER BY awards DESC LIMIT 5

question: At {venue}, under any of its names, how many matches were won by the side batting first and how many by the side chasing?
paraphrases: Is {venue} a ground where you should bat first or chase?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match)-[:HOSTED_AT]->(v:Venue) WHERE v.name = $venue OR v.name STARTS WITH $venue + ', ' OPTIONAL MATCH (:Team)-[w:WON]->(m) RETURN sum(CASE WHEN m.win_by_runs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS batting_first_won, sum(CASE WHEN w.by_wickets IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_won

question: Which fielder has taken the most catches off {bowler}'s bowling?
cypher: MATCH (bw:Player {name: $bowler})-[d:DISMISSED]->(x:Player)<-[f:FIELDED_DISMISSAL]-(fl:Player) WHERE d.kind = 'caught' AND f.kind = 'caught' AND f.match_file_id = d.match_file_id AND f.over = d.over RETURN fl.name AS fielder, count(*) AS catches ORDER BY catches DESC LIMIT 5

question: When was each player born?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player) WHERE p.born IS NOT NULL RETURN p.name AS player, p.born AS born

question: Who captained {team} most often?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:CAPTAINED]->(t:Team {name: $team}) RETURN p.name AS captain, count(*) AS matches ORDER BY matches DESC

question: Which match drew the biggest crowd?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match) WHERE m.attendance IS NOT NULL RETURN m.date AS date, m.attendance AS crowd ORDER BY crowd DESC LIMIT 1
